=============================
Best Practice structure
==============================
.github/workflows

release.yml

security-scheduled.yml
security-notification.yml

codeql.yml
codeql-notification.yml

dependabot-notification.yml

security/
├── sca-trivy.yml
├── gitleaks.yml
├── sonar.yml
└── security-gate.yml


==============================
1. security-scheduled.yml
==============================

name: Security - Scheduled

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 2 * * *"

  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:

  trivy-sca:
    name: Trivy Dependency Scan
    uses: ./.github/workflows/sca-trivy.yml

  notify-status:

    name: Security Summary

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    needs:
      - trivy-sca

    if: always()

    steps:

      - name: Security Scan Completed
        run: |
          echo "Security workflow completed"

====================================================================================================================
2. sca-trivy.yml
===========================================
name: Security - SCA

on:

  workflow_call:

  pull_request:
    branches:
      - develop
      - main

  push:
    branches:
      - develop
      - main

  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  security-events: write

jobs:

  trivy-sca:

    name: Trivy Dependency Scan

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:

      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Cache Trivy
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/trivy
          key: trivy-${{ runner.os }}

      - name: Run Trivy Scan
        uses: aquasecurity/trivy-action@master
        with:
          scan-type: fs
          scan-ref: .
          scanners: vuln
          severity: CRITICAL,HIGH
          ignore-unfixed: true
          format: json
          output: trivy-results.json
          exit-code: '1'

      - name: Upload Trivy Report
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: trivy-results
          path: trivy-results.json

  pnpm-audit:

    name: pnpm Dependency Audit

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:

      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 9

      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: pnpm

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run Audit
        run: |
          pnpm audit --json > pnpm-audit.json

      - name: Upload pnpm Report
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: pnpm-audit-report
          path: pnpm-audit.json

===========================================================================================
3. security-notification.yml
============================================================================================
name: Security - Notification

on:

  workflow_run:
    workflows:
      - Security - Scheduled

    types:
      - completed

permissions:
  actions: read
  contents: read

jobs:

  notify-security-team:

    if: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'failure' }}

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:

      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Download Trivy Report
        uses: dawidd6/action-download-artifact@v3
        with:
          workflow: security-scheduled.yml
          workflow_conclusion: failure
          name: trivy-results
          path: reports

      - name: Extract Findings
        id: findings
        run: |

          CRITICAL=$(jq '[.. | .Severity? | select(.=="CRITICAL")] | length' reports/trivy-results.json)

          HIGH=$(jq '[.. | .Severity? | select(.=="HIGH")] | length' reports/trivy-results.json)

          PACKAGES=$(jq -r '
          ..
          | .PkgName?
          | select(. != null)
          ' reports/trivy-results.json | sort -u | head -10)

          {
            echo "critical=${CRITICAL}"
            echo "high=${HIGH}"

            echo "packages<<EOF"
            echo "$PACKAGES"
            echo "EOF"

          } >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Send Slack Alert

        env:

          WEBHOOK: ${{ secrets.SECURITY_SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}

          CRITICAL_COUNT: ${{ steps.findings.outputs.critical }}

          HIGH_COUNT: ${{ steps.findings.outputs.high }}

          PACKAGES: ${{ steps.findings.outputs.packages }}

          REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}

          BRANCH: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_branch }}

          WORKFLOW_URL: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.html_url }}

        run: |

          curl -X POST \
          -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
          --data "{

            \"text\":\"Security Findings Detected\",

            \"blocks\": [

              {
                \"type\":\"header\",
                \"text\":{
                  \"type\":\"plain_text\",
                  \"text\":\"🚨 Security Vulnerabilities Detected\"
                }
              },

              {
                \"type\":\"section\",
                \"fields\": [

                  {
                    \"type\":\"mrkdwn\",
                    \"text\":\"*Repository:*\\n${REPOSITORY}\"
                  },

                  {
                    \"type\":\"mrkdwn\",
                    \"text\":\"*Branch:*\\n${BRANCH}\"
                  },

                  {
                    \"type\":\"mrkdwn\",
                    \"text\":\"*Critical:*\\n${CRITICAL_COUNT}\"
                  },

                  {
                    \"type\":\"mrkdwn\",
                    \"text\":\"*High:*\\n${HIGH_COUNT}\"
                  }

                ]
              },

              {
                \"type\":\"section\",
                \"text\":{
                  \"type\":\"mrkdwn\",
                  \"text\":\"*Affected Packages:*\\n${PACKAGES}\"
                }
              },

              {
                \"type\":\"actions\",
                \"elements\":[

                  {
                    \"type\":\"button\",
                    \"text\":{
                      \"type\":\"plain_text\",
                      \"text\":\"View Findings\"
                    },
                    \"url\":\"${WORKFLOW_URL}\"
                  }

                ]
              }

            ]

          }" \
          "$WEBHOOK"




========================================================================================
security-scheduled.yml becomes the orchestrator, sca-trivy.yml becomes the reusable scanner, and security-notification.yml becomes the reporting layer. This separation is cleaner, easier to maintain, and scales well when you later add Gitleaks, CodeQL, Semgrep, or other security tools.

=====================================
jobs:
  sca:
    uses: ./.github/workflows/sca-trivy.yml

  secret:
    uses: ./.github/workflows/secret-scan.yml

  codeql:
    uses: ./.github/workflows/codeql.yml


===========================================================
.github/workflows/codeql.yml

the problem codeQl is here to solve:
1. SQL Injection
2. Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
3. Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)
4. Command Injection
5. Path Traversal
6. Hardcoded Credentials
7. Authentication Flaws
8. Authorization Flaws
9. Insecure Deserialization
10. Sensitive Data Exposure
11. Weak Cryptography
12. Unsafe Redirects

`=========================================================
name: Security - CodeQL

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
      - develop

permissions:
  actions: read
  contents: read
  security-events: write

jobs:
  analyze:

    name: CodeQL Analysis

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    strategy:
      fail-fast: false

      matrix:
        language:
          - javascript-typescript

    steps:

      - name: Checkout Source
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Initialize CodeQL
        uses: github/codeql-action/init@v3
        with:
          languages: ${{ matrix.language }}

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20

      - name: Install pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 9

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Build Application
        run: pnpm build

      - name: Run CodeQL Analysis
        uses: github/codeql-action/analyze@v3


===================================================
Tool	Main Problem Solved	OwnerCodeQL	Insecure Application Code	Developers
SonarQube	Code Quality + Bugs	Developers
Dependabot	Vulnerable Dependencies	DevOps + Developers
Trivy SCA	Dependency Vulnerabilities	DevOps + Developers
Gitleaks	Secret Exposure	Security / DevOps
Terraform Scan	Infrastructure Misconfigurations	DevOps
=================================================================
================================
FOR TRIVY IMAGE SCAN

Yes. Trivy FS:Trivy FS (Filesystem Scan) and Trivy Image Scan are related, but they scan different things.

Trivy FS (Filesystem Scan):Scans your repository contents before a Docker image is built
example:
package.json
pnpm-lock.yaml
pom.xml
build.gradle
requirements.txt
go.mod

Trivy Image:
=
"Is my final Docker image vulnerable?"

Ubuntu packages
Alpine packages
OpenSSL
Java runtime
Node runtime
Operating system libraries

=========================
Design my pipeline for this policy:
Critical = Fail
High     = Fail
Medium   = Warn
Low      = Report Only
=======================================================
release-image-security.yml
=========================================================
name: Release Container Image

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:

  build-and-scan:

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:

      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Configure AWS Credentials
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4
        with:
          role-to-assume: ${{ secrets.AWS_GITHUB_ROLE }}
          aws-region: eu-west-1

      - name: Login to ECR
        uses: aws-actions/amazon-ecr-login@v2

      # ==========================================
      # BUILD IMAGE
      # ==========================================

      - name: Build Docker Image
        run: |
          docker build \
            -t fintech-api:${{ github.sha }} \
            .

    # ==========================================
# TRIVY IMAGE SCAN
# ==========================================

- name: Scan Docker Image
  uses: aquasecurity/trivy-action@master
  with:
    image-ref: fintech-api:${{ github.sha }}
    format: json
    output: trivy-image-results.json
    severity: CRITICAL,HIGH,MEDIUM,LOW
    ignore-unfixed: true
    exit-code: '0'

# ==========================================
# EVALUATE SECURITY POLICY
# ==========================================

- name: Evaluate Security Policy
  id: security-gate
  shell: bash
  run: |

    CRITICAL=$(jq '[.. | .Severity? | select(.=="CRITICAL")] | length' trivy-image-results.json)
    HIGH=$(jq '[.. | .Severity? | select(.=="HIGH")] | length' trivy-image-results.json)
    MEDIUM=$(jq '[.. | .Severity? | select(.=="MEDIUM")] | length' trivy-image-results.json)
    LOW=$(jq '[.. | .Severity? | select(.=="LOW")] | length' trivy-image-results.json)

    STATUS="PASS"
    ALERT_TYPE="NONE"

    if [ "$CRITICAL" -gt 0 ]; then
      STATUS="FAIL"
      ALERT_TYPE="TRIVY-IMAGE-CRITICAL"
    elif [ "$HIGH" -gt 0 ]; then
      STATUS="FAIL"
      ALERT_TYPE="TRIVY-IMAGE-HIGH"
    elif [ "$MEDIUM" -gt 0 ]; then
      STATUS="WARN"
      ALERT_TYPE="TRIVY-IMAGE-MEDIUM"
    fi

    echo "critical=$CRITICAL" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
    echo "high=$HIGH" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
    echo "medium=$MEDIUM" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
    echo "low=$LOW" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

    echo "status=$STATUS" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
    echo "alert_type=$ALERT_TYPE" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

# ==========================================
# SEND SLACK ALERT
# ==========================================

- name: Send Security Alert
  if: |
    steps.security-gate.outputs.status == 'FAIL' ||
    steps.security-gate.outputs.status == 'WARN'

  env:
    WEBHOOK: ${{ secrets.SECURITY_SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}

    STATUS: ${{ steps.security-gate.outputs.status }}
    ALERT_TYPE: ${{ steps.security-gate.outputs.alert_type }}

    CRITICAL: ${{ steps.security-gate.outputs.critical }}
    HIGH: ${{ steps.security-gate.outputs.high }}
    MEDIUM: ${{ steps.security-gate.outputs.medium }}
    LOW: ${{ steps.security-gate.outputs.low }}

    REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}

  run: |

    curl -X POST \
      -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
      --data "{

        \"text\":\"[TRIVY-IMAGE] Security Findings Detected\",

        \"blocks\": [

          {
            \"type\":\"header\",
            \"text\":{
              \"type\":\"plain_text\",
              \"text\":\"🚨 [TRIVY-IMAGE] Container Image Scan\"
            }
          },

          {
            \"type\":\"section\",
            \"fields\": [

              {
                \"type\":\"mrkdwn\",
                \"text\":\"*Repository:*\\n${REPOSITORY}\"
              },

              {
                \"type\":\"mrkdwn\",
                \"text\":\"*Status:*\\n${STATUS}\"
              },

              {
                \"type\":\"mrkdwn\",
                \"text\":\"*Critical:*\\n${CRITICAL}\"
              },

              {
                \"type\":\"mrkdwn\",
                \"text\":\"*High:*\\n${HIGH}\"
              },

              {
                \"type\":\"mrkdwn\",
                \"text\":\"*Medium:*\\n${MEDIUM}\"
              },

              {
                \"type\":\"mrkdwn\",
                \"text\":\"*Low:*\\n${LOW}\"
              }

            ]
          }

        ]

      }" \
      "$WEBHOOK"

# ==========================================
# FAIL SECURITY GATE
# ==========================================

- name: Enforce Security Policy
  if: steps.security-gate.outputs.status == 'FAIL'
  run: |
    echo "Critical or High vulnerabilities detected."
    exit 1
      # ==========================================
      # TAG IMAGE
      # ==========================================

      - name: Tag Image
        run: |
          docker tag \
            fintech-api:${{ github.sha }} \
            ${{ vars.ECR_REPOSITORY }}:${{ github.sha }}

      # ==========================================
      # PUSH IMAGE
      # ==========================================

      - name: Push Image
        run: |
          docker push \
            ${{ vars.ECR_REPOSITORY }}:${{ github.sha }}     
      # PUSH ONLY IF SECURITY GATE PASSES
      # ==========================================

      - name: Tag Image
        run: |
          docker tag \
            fintech-api:${{ github.sha }} \
            ${{ vars.ECR_REPOSITORY }}:${{ github.sha }}

      - name: Push Image
        run: |
          docker push \
            ${{ vars.ECR_REPOSITORY }}:${{ github.sha }}

Production-Ready dependabot.yml
====================================
version: 2

updates:

  # ==========================================================
  # NPM / PNPM DEPENDENCIES
  # ==========================================================

  - package-ecosystem: "npm"
    directory: "/"

    schedule:
      interval: "weekly"
      day: "monday"
      time: "02:00"
      timezone: "Africa/Lagos"

    open-pull-requests-limit: 5

    labels:
      - "security:automated"
      - "scanner:sca"
      - "type:dependency"

    commit-message:
      prefix: "deps"

    reviewers:
      - "Coreinfra-Labs/security"

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # BLOCK MAJOR VERSION UPDATES
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    ignore:
      - dependency-name: "*"
        update-types:
          - "version-update:semver-major"

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # GROUP RELATED PACKAGES
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    groups:

      nx:
        patterns:
          - "@nx/*"
          - "nx"

      angular:
        patterns:
          - "@angular/*"

      react:
        patterns:
          - "react"
          - "react-*"
          - "@types/react*"

      typescript:
        patterns:
          - "typescript"
          - "@types/node"

      testing:
        patterns:
          - "jest"
          - "@jest/*"
          - "vitest"
          - "@playwright/*"
          - "playwright"

      eslint:
        patterns:
          - "eslint"
          - "@eslint/*"
          - "typescript-eslint"
          - "@typescript-eslint/*"

  # ==========================================================
  # GITHUB ACTIONS
  # ==========================================================

  - package-ecosystem: "github-actions"
    directory: "/"

    schedule:
      interval: "weekly"
      day: "monday"
      time: "02:30"
      timezone: "Africa/Lagos"

    open-pull-requests-limit: 5

    labels:
      - "security:automated"
      - "scanner:sca"
      - "type:dependency"

    commit-message:
      prefix: "ci"

    reviewers:
      - "Coreinfra-Labs/devsecops"

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # BLOCK MAJOR ACTION CHANGES
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    ignore:
      - dependency-name: "*"
        update-types:
          - "version-update:semver-major"
   

    groups:

      github-actions:
        patterns:
          - "*"
=================================================
Adding a monthly major-update review workflow
Create:
.github/workflows/dependabot-major-review.yml
This workflow will run on the first day of every month and look for outdated npm dependencies where a newer major version exists.

########################################################
what you will see in slack 

This doesn't create PRs

It's simply your monthly reminder:
"These dependencies have major versions available. Decide which ones you want to investigate."

📋 Monthly Major Dependency Review

Repository: company/my-app
Major updates available: 3

• react 18.3.1 → 19.1.0
  Compatible version: 18.3.1

• eslint 8.57.0 → 9.35.0
  Compatible version: 8.57.0

• playwright 1.52.0 → 2.0.0
  Compatible version: 1.52.0

🔎 Action: Review these major updates manually.



########################################################
------------------------------------------------------
name: Dependabot Major Version Review

on:
  schedule:
    # First day of every month at 09:00 UTC
    - cron: "0 9 1 * *"

  # Allow manual execution
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  major-review:
    name: Review Major Dependency Updates
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22

      - name: Check for major dependency updates
        id: outdated
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts

          npm outdated --json > outdated.json || true

          cat outdated.json

      - name: Send major update report to Slack
        env:
          SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL: ${{ secrets.SECURITY_SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          python <<'PY'
          import json
          import os
          import urllib.request

          try:
              with open("outdated.json", "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                  outdated = json.load(f)
          except (FileNotFoundError, json.JSONDecodeError):
              outdated = {}

          major_updates = []

          for name, info in outdated.items():
              current = info.get("current")
              wanted = info.get("wanted")
              latest = info.get("latest")

              if not current or not latest:
                  continue

              def major(version):
                  try:
                      version = version.lstrip("v")
                      return int(version.split(".")[0])
                  except (ValueError, IndexError):
                      return None

              current_major = major(current)
              latest_major = major(latest)

              if (
                  current_major is not None
                  and latest_major is not None
                  and latest_major > current_major
              ):
                  major_updates.append({
                      "name": name,
                      "current": current,
                      "wanted": wanted,
                      "latest": latest
                  })

          if not major_updates:
              print("No major dependency updates found.")
              raise SystemExit(0)

          lines = [
              "📋 *Monthly Major Dependency Review*",
              "",
              f"*Repository:* {os.environ['GITHUB_REPOSITORY']}",
              f"*Major updates available:* {len(major_updates)}",
              ""
          ]

          for item in major_updates:
              lines.append(
                  f"• *{item['name']}* "
                  f"`{item['current']}` → `{item['latest']}`"
              )

              if item["wanted"]:
                  lines.append(
                      f"  Compatible version: `{item['wanted']}`"
                  )

              lines.append("")

          lines.extend([
              "🔎 *Action:* Review these major updates manually.",
              "",
              f"<{os.environ['GITHUB_SERVER_URL']}/"
              f"{os.environ['GITHUB_REPOSITORY']}/"
              f"actions/runs/{os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_ID']}|"
              "View workflow>"
          ])

          payload = json.dumps({
              "text": "\n".join(lines)
          }).encode("utf-8")

          request = urllib.request.Request(
              os.environ["SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL"],
              data=payload,
              headers={
                  "Content-Type": "application/json"
              },
              method="POST"
          )

          with urllib.request.urlopen(request) as response:
              if response.status < 200 or response.status >= 300:
                  raise RuntimeError(
                      f"Slack returned HTTP {response.status}"
                  )

          print(
              f"Sent report containing "
              f"{len(major_updates)} major update(s)."
          )
          PY

.github/workflows/dependabot-notification.yml
=================================================
name: Dependabot Notification

on:
  pull_request:
    types:
      - opened

permissions:
  pull-requests: read

jobs:

  notify:

    if: github.actor == 'dependabot[bot]'

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:

      - name: Send Slack Notification
        env:
          WEBHOOK: ${{ secrets.SECURITY_SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}
          REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
          PR_TITLE: ${{ github.event.pull_request.title }}
          PR_URL: ${{ github.event.pull_request.html_url }}
          AUTHOR: ${{ github.actor }}

        run: |
          curl -X POST \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            --data "$(jq -n \
              --arg repo "$REPOSITORY" \
              --arg author "$AUTHOR" \
              --arg title "$PR_TITLE" \
              --arg url "$PR_URL" \
              '{
                text: "📦 [DEPENDABOT] Dependency Update Created",
                blocks: [
                  {
                    type: "header",
                    text: {
                      type: "plain_text",
                      text: "📦 [DEPENDABOT] Dependency Update Created"
                    }
                  },
                  {
                    type: "section",
                    fields: [
                      {
                        type: "mrkdwn",
                        text: ("*Alert Type:*\nDEPENDABOT")
                      },
                      {
                        type: "mrkdwn",
                        text: ("*Repository:*\n" + $repo)
                      },
                      {
                        type: "mrkdwn",
                        text: ("*Created By:*\n" + $author)
                      }
                    ]
                  },
                  {
                    type: "section",
                    text: {
                      type: "mrkdwn",
                      text: ("*Pull Request:*\n" + $title)
                    }
                  },
                  {
                    type: "actions",
                    elements: [
                      {
                        type: "button",
                        text: {
                          type: "plain_text",
                          text: "View PR"
                        },
                        url: $url
                      }
                    ]
                  }
                ]
              }')" \
            "$WEBHOOK"

=============================================
depndabot-security-notification.yaml
============================================
name: Dependabot Security Notification

on:
  schedule:
    # Run every hour
    - cron: "0 * * * *"

  # Allow manual execution from GitHub Actions
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  vulnerability-alerts: read
  actions: read

concurrency:
  group: dependabot-security-notification
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  security-alerts:
    name: Check Dependabot Security Alerts
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # ---------------------------------------------------------
      # 1. Find the previous successful run
      # ---------------------------------------------------------
      - name: Find previous successful run
        id: previous-run
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          API_URL="https://api.github.com/repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/actions/workflows/dependabot-security-notification.yml/runs?status=success&per_page=2"

          curl --fail-with-body \
            --silent \
            --show-error \
            --request GET \
            --url "$API_URL" \
            --header "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
            --header "Authorization: Bearer ${GH_TOKEN}" \
            --header "X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2026-03-10" \
            --output workflow-runs.json

          python <<'PY'
          import json
          import os

          with open("workflow-runs.json", "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
              data = json.load(f)

          runs = data.get("workflow_runs", [])

          # The current run is not successful yet, so the first
          # successful run should normally be the previous run.
          if not runs:
              print("No previous successful run found.")
              print("This is the first run.")
              with open(os.environ["GITHUB_OUTPUT"], "a") as output:
                  output.write("first_run=true\n")
                  output.write("previous_run_time=\n")
          else:
              previous = runs[0]

              created_at = previous["created_at"]

              print(f"Previous successful run: {previous['id']}")
              print(f"Previous run started: {created_at}")

              with open(os.environ["GITHUB_OUTPUT"], "a") as output:
                  output.write("first_run=false\n")
                  output.write(f"previous_run_time={created_at}\n")
          PY

      # ---------------------------------------------------------
      # 2. Get Dependabot alerts
      # ---------------------------------------------------------
      - name: Fetch Dependabot alerts
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          PREVIOUS_RUN_TIME: ${{ steps.previous-run.outputs.previous_run_time }}
          FIRST_RUN: ${{ steps.previous-run.outputs.first_run }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          OWNER="${GITHUB_REPOSITORY_OWNER}"
          REPO="${GITHUB_REPOSITORY#*/}"

          echo "Repository: ${OWNER}/${REPO}"

          curl --fail-with-body \
            --silent \
            --show-error \
            --request GET \
            --url "https://api.github.com/repos/${OWNER}/${REPO}/dependabot/alerts?state=open%2Cfixed%2Cdismissed%2Cauto_dismissed&sort=updated&direction=desc&per_page=100" \
            --header "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
            --header "Authorization: Bearer ${GH_TOKEN}" \
            --header "X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2026-03-10" \
            --output dependabot-alerts.json

          python <<'PY'
          import json
          import os
          from datetime import datetime, timezone

          with open("dependabot-alerts.json", "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
              alerts = json.load(f)

          previous_run = os.environ.get("PREVIOUS_RUN_TIME", "")
          first_run = os.environ.get("FIRST_RUN") == "true"

          def parse_timestamp(value):
              if not value:
                  return None

              return datetime.fromisoformat(
                  value.replace("Z", "+00:00")
              )

          if first_run:
              # On the first run, only report currently OPEN alerts.
              changed_alerts = [
                  alert
                  for alert in alerts
                  if alert.get("state") == "open"
              ]

              print(
                  f"First run: found {len(changed_alerts)} "
                  "currently open alert(s)."
              )

          else:
              previous_time = parse_timestamp(previous_run)

              changed_alerts = []

              for alert in alerts:
                  updated_at = parse_timestamp(
                      alert.get("updated_at")
                  )

                  if updated_at and updated_at > previous_time:
                      changed_alerts.append(alert)

              print(
                  f"Found {len(changed_alerts)} alert(s) "
                  f"updated since {previous_run}."
              )

          with open(
              "changed-dependabot-alerts.json",
              "w",
              encoding="utf-8"
          ) as f:
              json.dump(
                  changed_alerts,
                  f,
                  indent=2
              )
          PY

      # ---------------------------------------------------------
      # 3. Send only new/changed alerts to Slack
      # ---------------------------------------------------------
      - name: Send Dependabot security notifications to Slack
        env:
          SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          python <<'PY'
          import json
          import os
          import urllib.request

          with open(
              "changed-dependabot-alerts.json",
              "r",
              encoding="utf-8"
          ) as f:
              alerts = json.load(f)

          if not alerts:
              print("No new or changed Dependabot alerts.")
              raise SystemExit(0)

          messages = []

          for alert in alerts:
              number = alert.get("number", "unknown")
              state = alert.get("state", "unknown")

              dependency = alert.get("dependency") or {}
              package = dependency.get("package") or {}

              package_name = package.get(
                  "name",
                  "Unknown dependency"
              )

              ecosystem = package.get(
                  "ecosystem",
                  "unknown"
              )

              advisory = alert.get("security_advisory") or {}

              severity = (
                  advisory.get("severity")
                  or "unknown"
              ).upper()

              summary = advisory.get(
                  "summary",
                  "Known vulnerability detected"
              )

              cve = advisory.get("cve_id")
              ghsa = advisory.get("ghsa_id")

              vulnerability = (
                  alert.get("security_vulnerability")
                  or {}
              )

              vulnerable_range = vulnerability.get(
                  "vulnerable_version_range",
                  "unknown"
              )

              patched = (
                  vulnerability.get(
                      "first_patched_version"
                  )
                  or {}
              )

              patched_version = patched.get(
                  "identifier"
              )

              alert_url = alert.get(
                  "html_url",
                  ""
              )

              if state == "open":
                  if patched_version:
                      event = "🚨 Vulnerability Update"
                  else:
                      event = "🚨 New Security Vulnerability"

              elif state == "fixed":
                  event = "✅ Vulnerability Fixed"

              elif state == "dismissed":
                  event = "⚠️ Vulnerability Dismissed"

              elif state == "auto_dismissed":
                  event = "⚠️ Vulnerability Auto-Dismissed"

              else:
                  event = "🔔 Dependabot Security Alert"

              lines = [
                  f"*{event}*",
                  "",
                  f"*Repository:* {os.environ['GITHUB_REPOSITORY']}",
                  f"*Dependency:* `{package_name}`",
                  f"*Ecosystem:* `{ecosystem}`",
                  f"*Severity:* `{severity}`",
                  f"*State:* `{state}`",
                  f"*Alert:* #{number}",
                  "",
                  f"*Summary:* {summary}",
                  f"*Vulnerable range:* `{vulnerable_range}`",
              ]

              if patched_version:
                  lines.append(
                      f"*Patched version:* `{patched_version}`"
                  )
              else:
                  lines.append(
                      "*Patched version:* Not currently available"
                  )

              if cve:
                  lines.append(f"*CVE:* `{cve}`")

              if ghsa:
                  lines.append(f"*GHSA:* `{ghsa}`")

              if alert_url:
                  lines.append(
                      f"<{alert_url}|View Dependabot Alert>"
                  )

              messages.append("\n".join(lines))

          # Send each alert separately so one Slack message
          # corresponds to one security event.
          for message in messages:
              payload = json.dumps({
                  "text": message
              }).encode("utf-8")

              request = urllib.request.Request(
                  os.environ["SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL"],
                  data=payload,
                  headers={
                      "Content-Type": "application/json"
                  },
                  method="POST"
              )

              with urllib.request.urlopen(request) as response:
                  if response.status < 200 or response.status >= 300:
                      raise RuntimeError(
                          f"Slack returned HTTP {response.status}"
                      )

          print(
              f"Sent {len(messages)} security notification(s) to Slack."
          )
          PY

===============================================
.github/workflows/

├── dependabot-notification.yml
│       │
│       └── Dependabot PR opened
│              ↓
│            Slack 📦
│
├── dependabot-security-notification.yml
│       │
│       └── Dependabot vulnerability
│              ↓
│            Slack 🚨
│
├── dependabot-major-review.yml
│       │
│       └── Monthly major-version review
│              ↓
│            Slack 📋
│
└── security-scheduled.yml
        │
        └── Trivy scan
               ↓
             Slack 🔐

This is a much better operational model than saying "never upgrade major versions."

You're essentially saying:

"Don't let major upgrades happen automatically, but don't let them disappear either."


============================================
Better Dependabot Strategy

I usually recommend:

Auto-merge
i)Patch Updates low Risk:
1.20.1 → 1.20.2

ii)Manual Review
1.20.1 → 1.21.0
Show more lines

iii)Strict Review
Major Updates
1.20.1 → 5.6.0
Show more lines
